objective: Measure whether greater SNO depth improves generalization to held-out media after controlling data allocation, representation and parameter count

problem.medium_definition: active circle mask plus exact DG0 alpha and n; centers/radii fixed
problem.active_count_distribution: uniform integer; training stratified across counts
problem.mask_distribution: uniform subset conditional on active count
problem.coefficient_distribution: independent log-uniform per active circle; background=1
problem.test_population: independent draws of the same declared medium distribution; no arbitrary moving-geometry claim

budget.unit: one complex FEM field at one mesh/medium/k/theta

scout.preprocessing: each arm fits its own output POD and all statistics on its own train subset only
scout.input_encoding: known 24 circle contrasts for alpha plus 24 for n; train-only feature scaling

selection_policy.score: macro-medium mean of 0.5 shared-query +0.3 frequency-interpolation +0.2 shifted-angle cohort means
selection_policy.rule: many_media_sparse_k must satisfy all thresholds versus BOTH other scout arms, using seed-averaged paired per-medium validation scores

evaluation.frequency_policy: five common train anchors; disjoint reserved interlaced val/test frequencies outside train master20
evaluation.material_split: all queries of a physical medium stay in one split; exact DG0 hash deduplication
evaluation.test_policy: sealed until all allocation, preprocessing, architecture and optimizer choices are frozen
evaluation.claims: new media; separate joint new-medium/frequency and new-medium/angle cohorts; no isolated seen-medium angular claim

physics_gate.production_h: selected by independent QA, not assumed from the retained static dataset
physics_gate.interpretation: sampled mesh-stability policy, not a proven continuum-error bound
checks: exact DG0 material identity across meshes
stratified endpoint-k and high-contrast h/h2 and selected h/4
physics_gate.failure_policy: halt and revise the entire recipe/mesh; count all attempts; never drop hard test rows
physics_gate.exterior_accuracy: requires a separately budgeted boundary/domain study; finite-domain surrogate is the primary claim

representation_gate.input: exact known 24-mask contrasts; learned input-POD is a separate controlled ablation
representation_gate.scout_output: same rank cap, separate own-train POD per arm; report each exact consistent-mass decoder floor
representation_gate.final_rank_selection: validation-only exact consistent-mass oracle projection; freeze one POD and stats for every depth/init seed

depth_study.matched_parameter_target: depth12,width64 at the same frozen modal dimension R
depth_study.training_budget: equal optimizer-update ceiling plus separately recorded wall time; compare compute curves, not epochs alone
depth_study.winner_selection: validation only; final test is a preregistered confirmation, not a selection round
depth_study.statistics: paired resampling of whole test media; seed spread separately; CI crossing zero means inconclusive
depth_study.primary_confirmatory_contrast: depth12,H64 versus depth3,matched-parameter width, at the same frozen R and preprocessing
depth_study.secondary_comparisons: fixed-width and depth6 comparisons are reported separately; test does not choose a winning architecture

implementation_blockers: new hierarchical M*F*D recipe with frequency/query/cohort IDs
compact per-medium material storage and batched gather; avoid dense repeated DG0 arrays
val-only training mode and separate final-test evaluator
persisted shared preprocessing with independent POD/model seeds
medium-aware macro metrics and paired bootstrap

sources.title: NSNO, Chen et al., 2024, section 6.2
sources.support: 1000 train/100 test MNIST scatterers and four axial training waves; different operator/architecture

sources.title: WaveBench author Helmholtz loader
sources.support: defaults 49000/500/500 realizations; separate frequency datasets; not a sample-size prescription

sources.title: Spectral Neural Operators, v2, 2024
sources.support: coefficient-space framework; local POD-SNO is an adaptation, not the original architecture

sources.title: Owen, On dropping the first Sobol point, 2021
sources.support: no generic Sobol-net guarantee for arbitrary truncated sample counts; use explicit stratification here
